name: read-thread
description: Reads a Slack message thread, the parent message first and the replies oldest first, each with its ts, user id, text and reactions, a page at a time: hasMore says whether the thread goes on, and nextCursor, passed back as cursor, reads the next page. Takes the channel by name or id (list-channels lists them) and the parent message's ts, which read-channel-history answers.

channel.description: A channel name, with or without the leading #, or a channel id from list-channels.

threadTs.description: The ts of the thread's parent message, from read-channel-history.

limit.description: Maximum number of thread messages to return.

cursor.description: The nextCursor a previous call answered, to read the thread's next page. Omitted, the first page.
